card.title: How to Repair iPad Pro 10.5 not charging or not detected by pc

source.title: How to Repair iPad Pro 10.5 not charging or not detected by pc

claims.statement: iPad Pro 10.5 not charging and not seen by a PC, with a good dock flex, is usually Tristar U3500 (compatible with iPhone 7 / 7 Plus Tristar 610A3B).
Initial draw at power-on should be under about 100 mA; abnormal draw plus failed dock test points to U3500.

procedure: Remove shield, replace U3500; test charging and PC detection.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
